cff-version: 1.2.0
message: "If you use nirs4all-methods in academic work, please cite the software and the relevant foundational papers below."
title: "nirs4all-methods: A portable Partial Least Squares engine with a stable C ABI"
abstract: >-
  nirs4all-methods reimplements the Partial Least Squares family in C++17 behind a
  stable C ABI, with first-class bindings for Python, R, MATLAB, JavaScript /
  WebAssembly and Android. It targets near-infrared spectroscopy,
  chemometrics, omics and process monitoring, with Adaptive Operator-Mixture
  PLS (AOM-PLS) and Per-Operator-Per-Component PLS (POP-PLS) as scientific
  differentiators.
